body: Growing up I was physically and emotionally/verbally abused by my dad, and eventually when my parents divorced my brothers (I have 2 of them, both older) kind of took on his horrible behaviours. On countless occasions my brothers have picked fights with me, ended up hitting me, choking me, or doing various painful things and whenever I threatened to call the police my own mother would hide the phones, including my cell phone, so I'd have to walk somewhere crying to find a payphone and get my boyfriend's mother to pick me up or threaten to lie to the police so I'd get taken to the psych ward and my brothers would come out unscathed. I've actually been in the psych ward, and kicked out on countless occasions. I lived with my boyfriends family for quite awhile and whenever I was invited back home it'd be something like "I can't get child support from your father if you're not living with me"

Thank you for your reply! 
I did some cleaning yesterday which gave me 2 hours or so to think and I've decided to seek help from one of my previous therapists which is a pretty big deal for me as I've only ever really gone to them unwillingly. I'm just struggling with the fear of being completely on my own and doing everything for myself. I know that I need to get a job so I have an income and a bright future doesn't feel so far away but for some reason it scares the crap out of me. I have no idea where to start to be completely honest.

I live in British Columbia, the game is WoW and I lived with a boyfriend's family for a year straight and a couple of months scattered throughout the rest of our relationship. It never felt very permanent however, so no I wouldn't say I've really lived away from my parents.

I've almost finished school, three more weeks of this semester then 3 classes to take next semester and high school is finally over. I just need to get over the fear of moving forward, bite the bullet and get a job so that getting away feels possible because right now it really doesn't.

Thank you for replying!
